jobs.title: Projektbearbeitung Bereich Inland – Schwerpunkt Demokratie und Gesellschaft (w/m/d/k.A.)
jobs.reason: A full-time project-administration post in domestic democracy-and-society work that plausibly fits the candidate's project-coordination and research-support experience at an entry-to-junior level, though the exact seniority and skills profile are unclear from the brief listing. The thematic area (German democracy/society) is adjacent rather than core to the candidate's international-law and atrocity-prevention focus, which holds the interest pull down.
